name: diagonal_avenue
author: netmod (task diagave)
description: Diagonal avenues: draw two diagonal roads side by side and sc3netmod's DAV block turns them into one avenue with a tree median (each cell becomes the piece a lone diagonal would get; the cells beside the median become these variants). Art: stock 35 / 18004 / 1999 road half plus a median half with a tree from avenue 11204, built by `diagave.py art art` in this folder before install (the png folders are not shipped). Phase 1: straight bands with no other road touching them; junctions are later work.
